lines.en: My boomerang head parts the shallows.

lines.zh: 四只短腿在水底撑着走。
lines.en: Four stubby legs push along the bottom.
One flick of my tail fin carries me a stretch.

lines.zh: 从一块石头爬到另一块。
lines.en: I crawl from one stone to the next.
A row of prints stays in the mud.
I rest my skull on a rock.

lines.zh: 只露出两只眼睛在水面。
lines.en: Only my eyes break the surface.

lines.zh: 气泡从嘴边慢慢冒上来。
lines.en: Bubbles rise slowly from my mouth.
Water beads roll off my scales.

lines.zh: 我在泥里埋了半个身子。
lines.en: I've buried half of myself in mud.
Your reflection wavers in the water.
You caved in my muddy bank.

lines.zh: 你手上的肉味飘过来了。
lines.en: The smell of meat on you drifts over.
I watch you from under a lily pad.
Bending over, you look like prey.
You don't see me under the surface.
I'm judging whether you're worth biting.
The ripples on the water are mine.
You're too close to the water's edge.
I turn my boomerang skull toward you.

lines.zh: 尾巴受伤了，快给我食物！
lines.en: My tail is hurt! Feed me!
My ribs are broken! Give me meat!
My leg is hurt! Don't run!
My helmet is gone! Give me bones!

lines.zh: 发出湿润的咕哝声，似乎很饿。
lines.en: Makes a moist gurgling sound, as if very hungry.

lines.zh: 用长脖子触碰你，寻求食物。
lines.en: Uses its long neck to touch you, seeking food.

lines.zh: 张开嘴巴，期待着食物落下。
lines.en: Opens its mouth, awaiting food to fall.

lines.zh: 瞥见食物就兴奋地游过来。
lines.en: Swims over excitedly when it sees food.

lines.zh: 缓慢游动，享受着新发现的食物。
lines.en: Slowly swims, enjoying the newly discovered food.

lines.zh: 用头轻轻触碰你，请求食物。
lines.en: Gently touches you with its head, requesting food.

lines.zh: 吞下食物，发出满意的咕哝声。
lines.en: Swallows the food, making a satisfied gurgle.
Swims towards you, indicating you have food.

lines.zh: 围着你游动，寻求更多食物。
lines.en: Swims around you, seeking more food.

lines.zh: 用嘴叼起食物，慢慢咀嚼。
lines.en: Uses its mouth to pick up food, chewing slowly.

lines.zh: 给我一条鱼，我就不咬你。
lines.en: Give me a fish and I won't bite.

lines.zh: 你口袋里有生肉的味道。
lines.en: I smell raw meat in your pocket.

lines.zh: 我饿了，水底没什么可吃。
lines.en: I'm hungry; the bottom is bare.
Put your hand down; I'll bite gently.
Feed me and I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 我咬过比你好吃的东西。
lines.en: I've bitten tastier things than you.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点我就够得着。
lines.en: Come closer and I can reach it.

lines.zh: 突袭对手，头部撞击对方。
用力撞向其他生物，试图打败对手。
lines.en: Collides forcefully with other creatures, trying to defeat the opponent.

lines.zh: 与敌人近距离碰撞，试图击倒。
lines.en: Collides closely with enemies, trying to knock them down.

lines.zh: 用坚硬的头部撞击敌人，造成伤害。
lines.en: Butts into enemies with its hard head, causing damage.

lines.zh: 与对手激烈碰撞，展示力量。
lines.en: Collides intensely with the opponent, showing strength.

lines.zh: 头部猛烈撞击，试图压倒对手。
lines.en: Headbutts powerfully, trying to overpower the opponent.

lines.zh: 连续撞击，对对手造成连续伤害。
lines.en: Collides repeatedly, causing continuous damage to the opponent.

lines.zh: 用头部猛撞，迫使对手后退。
lines.en: Butts forcefully, making the opponent retreat.

lines.zh: 头对头碰撞，试图阻止对手。
lines.en: Collides heads, trying to stop the opponent.

lines.zh: 用头部撞击，试图打败对手。
lines.en: Butts with its head, trying to defeat the opponent.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的呼唤声，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Releases a low rumbling sound, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 靠近其他生物，试图吸引注意。
lines.en: Approaches other creatures, trying to attract attention.

lines.zh: 发出求偶信号，吸引配偶注意。
lines.en: Releases mating signals, attracting the mate's attention.

lines.zh: 游向可能的配偶，发出求偶声。
lines.en: Swims towards a possible mate, releasing mating sounds.
Approaches the female, making mating sounds.

lines.zh: 用头部轻触雌性，示意求偶。
lines.en: Gently touches the female with its head, indicating mating.

lines.zh: 发出求偶时特有的咕哝声。
与雌性进行求偶舞蹈，展示魅力。
lines.en: Performs a mating dance with the female, showing魅力.

lines.zh: 发出求偶声，吸引雌性注意。
lines.en: Releases mating sounds, attracting the female's attention.

lines.zh: 靠近雌性，发出求偶邀请。
lines.en: Approaches the female, offering mating invitation.

lines.zh: 低头看我，幼小的笠头螈。

lines.en: I touched you; now it's your turn.
I set my tail and get ready to lunge.
Wraps its long neck around you!
A ring of ripples rises in the shallows.
I poke half a head out of the mud.

lines.zh: 雨后的水洼多了个影子。
lines.en: A new shape appears in the rain puddle.

lines.zh: 我这颗平头在水里也喘不上气。
lines.en: Even my flat head can't breathe here.
The blast left my skull ringing.

lines.zh: 箭头扎进我的笠形头骨。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my boomerang skull.

lines.zh: 尾巴受伤了，快给我食物，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My tail is hurt! Feed me! — and the starvation makes it worse.
